status: declared by the pull request that closes #633 before any score was computed. Exploration on development data, not a record: nothing is published, nothing is written into docs/runs/, no day after 2025-12-31 is read, and under scoring protocol v1 (#640) development data never gives a verdict. The kill rule of H4 is applied as the queue (#46) states it, as exploration.
hypothesis: H4, step 2: longer history fixes part of 2018-19. Kill (#46): no 2014-18 series has an established posting time, or extended training moves 2018-19 calibration by less than its interval.
rulings: Eleonora, 12 October 2026 (#633, comment 6127634601): measure what the extended history does to the H5 spread forecast, under the scoring of #640, not the +5 bp judge's tiers
Eleonora, 13 October 2026 (PR #661, comment 6146010089): the back-fill workbook is public from 17 May 2018, one posting_instant for TGCR, BGCR and SOFR (metadata/backfill_posting.json)
target: spread_bps (SOFR - IORB, bp) at each lead h = 1..5 business days after the decision day, at the 23 levels of scoring_protocol.GRID

model.name: spread_qgbm_633
model.estimator: sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor, loss='quantile', one fit per lead and per level of scoring_protocol.GRID; a day's predicted quantiles are sorted
model.hyperparameters: ml.PRESSURE_CLASSIFIER_SETTINGS (learning_rate 0.05, max_iter 200, max_leaf_nodes 15, min_samples_leaf 20, random_state 0), the settings #632's spread model uses; none tuned
model.why_this_model: the H5 models on main (#632's) read inputs the back-fill does not carry (the SOFR percentiles, the settlement and H.4.1 timing and satiation-distance columns), so a back-filled row would train no pair and the arms could not differ. This model reads only inputs present in the back-filled rows, so the measurement isolates the history

inputs.not read: on_rrp: its registry entry (fred_macro_latest_vintage.RRPONTSYD) declares no availability relative to its row, so the as-of rule refuses it
the target at the anchor: spread_bps at the anchor minus the spread 5 rows before it

model.training_pairs: each label row s paired with what a forecast of s at lead h read at its own decision instant (InformationRule(horizon=h).observation), under both guards; a fit uses the labels observable at its block's decision instant (information-set rule 3)
model.refit: every 21 decision days (docs/decisions/information-set.md), one block for all leads

arms.without: trained on the published days only: the scratch panel of backfill_history.py panel (from 2018-04-03)
arms.with: the same model on the extended panel (backfill_history.py panel): the same rows from 2018-04-03 and the 899 back-filled rows from 2014-08-22 in every training frame. Each block passes backfill.require_training_only and backfill.require_posting_established with the declared posting instant

decision_days: every business day of the scratch panel from 2018-06-29 whose lead-5 target is on or before 2025-12-31 (2018-06-29 is the first scored day of the earlier back-fill measurement, #484, and its first fit ends 2018-06-27, after 17 May 2018)

scoring.primary: scoring_protocol.day_scores with grid_crps (mean over leads), paired per decision day; d = S(without) - S(with), positive when the history helps; scoring_protocol.paired_tests, stationary bootstrap, mean block 10, 10,000 draws, seed 633, one-sided 95% (the lower bound of mean d) and the two-sided 90% interval
scoring.calibration: per decision day, the share of leads whose outcome falls inside the central 90% interval (q0.05 to q0.95) and inside the central 50% interval (q0.25 to q0.75), and the share above q0.95; the move is with minus without, a mean of paired daily differences, with a two-sided 90% stationary-bootstrap interval on the same resample stream
scoring.context: both arms' CRPS skill against B1 (as-of persistence, protocol_benchmarks.b1_forecast on the scratch panel)
scoring.splits: pooled, by regime of metadata/evaluation_splits.json (2018-19 is the headline), and by the pressure-day type of the lead-1 target (SplitDeclaration.reporting_day_type)

kill_rule_reading: H4 is killed, as exploration, when the two-sided 90% interval of the 2018-19 move in 90%-interval coverage covers zero. The 50%-interval coverage and CRPS moves are reported beside it and do not change that reading
